request.style: English, Male baritone, soulful and weary, solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, gentle percussion, minor key, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Samuel was dead and buried in Ramah
Saul had driven mediums from the land
The Philistines camped at Shunem
Saul gathered Israel at Gilboa
He saw the army and his heart was gripped by terror
He inquired of the Lord for a sign

[Chorus]
The Lord gave no answer by dreams
Not by Urim nor by prophets
So find me a woman who is a medium
To consult a spirit in the night

[Verse]
There is a woman at En-Dor
Saul disguised himself in other clothes
He went with two men into the dark
And asked her to bring up the one he named
She warned him of the trap he was setting
But he swore by the Lord she would not be punished

[Chorus]
The Lord gave no answer by dreams
Not by Urim nor by prophets
So find me a woman who is a medium
To consult a spirit in the night

[Verse]
I see a divine being coming up
An old man wrapped in a robe is rising
Saul bowed low with his face to the ground
Asking why he had disturbed the spirit
He spoke of his distress and God’s silence
And called on Samuel to tell him what to do

[Chorus]
The Lord gave no answer by dreams
Not by Urim nor by prophets
So find me a woman who is a medium
To consult a spirit in the night

[Bridge]
Why ask me now that the Lord has turned away
He has torn the kingdom out of your hand
Given it to your neighbor, to David
Because you did not obey the voice of the Lord

[Outro]
The Lord will hand you and Israel over
Tomorrow you and your sons will be with me
